name: hydrocouplesdk
description: HydroCouple SDK — concrete base implementations of the HydroCouple v2 component-based modeling interfaces (typed hyperslab data plane, JSON/YAML argument IO, temporal and spatial data items).

hdf5.description: HDF5/UGRID output persistence (USE_HDF5=ON). Concurrency is guaranteed by the SDK's process-wide ioLibraryMutex(), held for every HDF5 and NetCDF call, not by HDF5's global-lock threadsafe mode — which the port declares incompatible with the high-level library that netcdf-c requires.

tools.description: Mesh generation tools: constrained Delaunay triangulation (MeshKit, fetched by CMake), quad-dominant meshing, curvilinear and terrain-following sigma grids (BUILD_TOOLS=ON)

gpu.description: Kokkos device backend (USE_KOKKOS=ON); pair with kokkos platform features for CUDA/HIP/SYCL
